honesty.no_rerun: This analysis uses existing Item063 full-slice data only and makes no Qwen/vLLM calls.
honesty.prompt_encoding_finding: The original in-loop prompt supplied visible assignments and graph edges but not explicit current per-vertex remaining domains/eliminated colors; explicit-state encoding removed value-misselection at full-slice scale, but full recall only partially recovered and does not establish the capacity law.
honesty.prompt_length_limit: Raw prompts/tokens were not persisted; prompt context is reconstructed as character/word-count proxy from static manifest plus logged cursor/chosen_color assignments.
honesty.register_occupancy_limit: Exact register occupancy history was not persisted. Capacity binding is inferred from runner status OVERFLOW_FAIL and effective-peak proxy; NO_RECOVERY_TARGET/CALL_CAP are not register-overflow successes.
honesty.retroactive_qualification: Earlier b2 calibrated capacity positive used isolated recall 0.524, not real in-loop recall 0.214; it is symbolic-mechanism evidence, not end-to-end LLM evidence until an in-loop framing that functions is used.

summary.rationale: Changing only the state encoding recovered the operator channel in the pilot and removed value-misselection at full-slice scale. Full explicit-state recall improves over the original implicit full slice but remains materially below isolated recall, and the solve curves remain censored/nonmonotone. The correct diagnosis is a uniform framing/state-encoding gap with partial full-slice recovery, not a demonstrated depth-context collapse or a validated end-to-end capacity law.
summary.slope_causality_note: Univariate depth/step slopes are descriptive and confounded by cell/status/recovery mixture; the explicit-state re-pilot is the discriminating evidence.
